title: ‘Rooting’ the commons: sharing lessons from Odisha, India and the South West of England
content:
A guest post by Amlan Mishra

A version of this post was presented at the ‘Law for the commons’ workshop at the Centre for Environmental Law and Sustainability (CELS), University of Bristol on 26 June, 2026 where several friends from Bristol Commons participated.

In this post, I hope to illuminate synergies between commons I study in Odisha, India and the commons we hope to grow in the city of Bristol – through commons movements in the city that I have been associated with. But what can I – a first-generation immigrant who moved to Bristol three years back – say about commons struggles in Bristol and the South West of England? All I can offer are some stories – some vignettes of my participation in these commons struggles. I hope to translate my PhD research which focuses on dispossession of forest commons in Odisha, India and use it as a vantage point to offer reflections from it.
